decisions.reason: As a 2018 CD tied to the core catalog and publicly backed on its own page, management is inclined to leave it in the broad warehouse assortment unless weak demand is clearly permanent.
Because this is a multi-model series that extends the firm's curated-edition strategy and required stronger visible commitment, escalation of commitment makes discontinuation comparatively unlikely.
A jazz reissue LP fits the label's reissue identity and genre-expansion plan, so management can justify keeping it on offer for another year despite only moderate sunk costs.
The multi-disc box set likely absorbed meaningful production effort and embodies the premium curation the firm wants to represent, which pushes management toward retaining it.
This compilation CD had the weakest public commitment and likely the lowest specific investment, so it is the easiest product for management to discontinue if results disappoint.
